purpose: Sets the quantity of one cart line and returns the refreshed line HTML, totals HTML and subtotal.

query.name: sciItemId
query.description: cart line id (shopping cart item id) from the data-sci-item attribute of the qty input on /cart

bodyFields.name: newQuantity
bodyFields.description: integer 1..10000; 0 or negative deletes the line (and answers 500); non-numeric/empty/>2147483647 gives 502

bodyFields.name: isCartPage
bodyFields.description: as sent by the page; also on query string (isCartPage=True)

success.bodySignal: JSON {success:true, SubTotal:'$958.00 excl tax', message:[], cartHtml, totalsHtml, displayCheckoutButtons:true, newItemPrice:'$479.00 excl tax'}; has $type field

failure.bodySignal: above max (10000): HTTP 200 + success:false + message ['The maximum quantity allowed for purchase is 10000.'], quantity unchanged, SubTotal of the old cart. Unknown/foreign sciItemId: HTTP 500 JSON {error:true,controller:'shoppingcart',action:'updatecartitem',message:'Object reference not set to an instance of an object.'}. newQuantity 0 or negative: same HTTP 500 body AND the line is deleted. Non-numeric, empty, decimal, 1e2, missing newQuantity or sciItemId, >2147483647: HTTP 502 text/html Bad Gateway (line unchanged). Body-less POST: 411. GET: 404.

purpose: Returns the counters for cart, wishlist and compare list (cart counter is the sum of line quantities); the page calls it after each quantity change.

success.bodySignal: JSON {CartItemsCount, WishlistItemsCount, CompareItemsCount} with $type; CartItemsCount = sum of quantities (e.g. 10005 for lines 3+10000+2)

purpose: Seed only: adds the product to the cart (same product merges into the existing line, quantity +1).
Seed only: quick add of product {id} from a listing; gift cards answer with a redirect to the product page instead.

success.bodySignal: JSON {success:true, message:'The product has been added to your shopping cart'}

purpose: Cleanup only: removes one cart line (owned by cart-remove).

success.bodySignal: JSON anonymous type with 6 fields (not inspected)
